The documented native playtest deferral is acceptable under the mission.

findings.actual: ApplySlotInvalidation sends the successful alias rebind to ObserveNativeCleanupOutcome. Its rebound branch calls ObserveBound at 9 after checking the companion. That replaces the interrupted choice at 4, so the next migration or save accepts 9.
findings.blocking_rationale: Native repair of an older binding can still move the player's shortcut without a toolbar edit.
findings.expected: The canonical choice remains at 4. A native rebind of the surviving older alias preserves its status as a secondary copy.
findings.requested_correction: Carry the selected slot through the native rebind callback. Preserve alias-only migration and continue to recognize a rebind at the selected slot as live.
findings.requested_evidence: Start with the mixed bar at 4 and 9, empty 4 with GetSlot, then let CleanupBadSlots rebind the stale alias at 9 to a live shell fact. Check that reconciliation and a save/reload each produce one public shortcut at 4.
findings.title: A native rebind can still promote the surviving legacy alias
findings.trigger: GetSlot empties the canonical shortcut at 4. Before KMC reconciles, CleanupBadSlots repairs the older Mount alias at 9 using a live fact of that blueprint.

findings.actual: IsStaleOrAlias returns false for the existing copy at 9 because it already holds the live fact's data. ObserveBindingAtBoundary consequently records 9 as a player placement, and LivePublicRows writes 9. The candidate's own save-first control for this same bar writes 3.
findings.blocking_rationale: Reading a stale slot changes what the next save restores even though the player made no edit.
findings.expected: Capture before and after the read both preserve the first canonical slot at 3. A genuinely new player placement remains authoritative.
findings.requested_correction: Distinguish a copy already present when the selected slot was emptied from a later player placement. Use that distinction in observation, reconciliation and capture.
findings.requested_evidence: Extend StaleThenCurrentCanonical by calling NativeInvalidateAt(3) before saving while 9 holds current data. Require one kind-6 row and one restored shortcut at 3. Retain the manual-move control.
findings.title: An already-live canonical copy still changes the archived slot
findings.trigger: Use the existing StaleThenCurrentCanonical bar with stale data at 3 and current data at 9. Native GetSlot empties 3 immediately before the save.

findings.actual: Live reconciliation keeps the surviving copy at 9 when the interrupted index is occupied. Capture skips that copy as secondary, finds the occupant at 4 and calls GiveUpOccupiedSlot. The archive then carries only the placement marker, so cold load loses the shortcut that live reconciliation keeps.
findings.blocking_rationale: The same bar and companion produce different arrangements depending on whether the player saves before the next update.
findings.expected: The unrelated ability remains at 4, and the continuing game and cold-loaded save agree on the shortcut. The handoff's stated fallback would keep one copy at 9.
findings.requested_correction: Apply one occupied-slot decision to live repair, archive capture and save-scope restoration.
findings.requested_evidence: After GetSlot empties 4 on MixedOlderBar, put Fireball at 4 and return the same pet. Compare update-first and save-first runs, including cold load and resave. Require identical public bindings and Fireball at 4.
findings.title: An occupied chosen slot produces different live and saved arrangements
findings.trigger: The player fills the interrupted slot at 4 while an older secondary binding survives at 9.

findings.actual: Every true IsBad result outside the CleanupBadSlots bracket calls ApplySlotInvalidation with rebound=false. Finalize2ControlsScenario.F2SlotKey directly calls IsBad on the raw slot array. Its removal case reads F2Bar immediately before explicitly emptying the slot. If the binding is stale, that inspection marks its index interrupted, allowing the next update to restore the deliberately removed shortcut.
findings.blocking_rationale: A diagnostic read can change the toolbar behavior it is observing and reverse a removal.
findings.expected: A validity query leaves placement intent untouched. An observed native replacement or emptying updates it.
findings.requested_correction: Bind invalidation to the actual GetSlot or CleanupBadSlots operation and its outcome. Keep a standalone IsBad query free of placement changes.
findings.requested_evidence: Query IsBad on a stale canonical slot with a live replacement fact, leave the slot in place, then deliberately remove it before reconciliation. Require a marker-only save and an empty slot after reload. Keep actual GetSlot emptying as the recovery control.
findings.title: A read-only IsBad query is recorded as a native slot removal
findings.trigger: A caller inspects a stale public shortcut directly, then deliberately removes it before KMC's next update.

findings.actual: The fenced callback retires A's arrangement in the outgoing records and returns while the rebound shortcut remains on the bar. Abandon restores the retirement. On the next update there is no stored pet ID left to compare, and Reconcile records the live slot for B. ObserveBound then clears the retirement.
findings.blocking_rationale: The surviving world can give a replacement companion the previous companion's retired shortcut and persist it.
findings.expected: Abandoning the load preserves the confirmed retirement and clears the obsolete binding before B can adopt it.
findings.requested_correction: Carry the cleanup required by a fenced retirement through abandonment and apply it to the surviving rider before ordinary bar observation.
findings.requested_evidence: Extend FencedRebindAbandoned with a direct change from A to B before the rebind. Abandon the load, reconcile and save. Require an empty old slot, no public row for B and an unchanged unrelated slot. Keep the same-A rebind and completed-load controls.
findings.title: An abandoned load can restore a retired binding for a replacement companion
findings.trigger: A rider has A's recorded shortcut at 9 and now links to B. Native cleanup rebinds the stale slot while a selected load fences the outgoing player, then that load is abandoned.
